coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Growing an email list is easy to say and hard to do. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, my newsletter list sat at 640 subscribers until I added a sign-up QR code at the till, and it reached 1,150 over one summer. That is the kind of practical, measurable fix your Campaign Operations team needs as it supports the growing APJ Marketing team.

As a Marketing Intern, I wrote and scheduled one newsletter a week in Mailchimp and checked every link and line of copy before it went out, which taught me how much a small error costs an email program. I also ran the Westbrook Film Society's social channels for two years, and I used Instagram Insights and Excel to see what lifted screening attendance from 35 to 60 per event. I haven't worked in Marketo yet, but I've completed the HubSpot Content Marketing course and Google Analytics for Beginners, and I'm keen to learn marketing automation and campaign performance reporting. Working across a global email program with Demand Generation, Field Marketing and Partner Marketing teams calls for the detail-orientation and tight-deadline discipline I built juggling a weekly publishing schedule alongside my studies.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your campaign execution. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Maya Linden
